Result: 83 classes (per j = 4..18: 1, 1, 3, 4, 9, 12, 21, 32), all multi-graviton. T-043(b).

code: code/fortuity/hwcoh (run_sectors, default engine, GROUP=G2, N=0, graviton generators up to n = 6 = top G2 Casimir degree); exact multiplicities from hwcoh.dims.partition_dims_nf(0, 18, group='G2')

checked: (i) per-sector self-check in all 170 sectors; (ii) completeness by enumeration: every (column, 2J) with letter content at j <= 18 present; (iii) Euler characteristic = exact refined BMN index (fortuity.bmn.groupindex, via scripts/bmn/so-usp-g2-scans/euler_check.py) in all 52 columns; (iv) identical m, r_up, grav to the 22 j = 12 sectors computed earlier (data/g2/g2_hw_cohomology_j12_extra.jsonl); (v) summing h and grav over the j = 18, 2J = 1 columns with the zero-weight multiplicities min(p,q)+1 gives 36 classes, all multi-graviton, in the (1;3,3,3) weight space, = R-010's independent weight-space computation. Single seed: random evaluation can only create spurious non-graviton classes, never hide one. Trace words span all G2 invariants for j <= 18 (R-010).
